verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework with a hosted Mastra Cloud deployment target, so a training-data opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training guarantee. Guardrails, observability datasets, and the ability to run locally are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
